'''Izumo-no-Iwai Shrine''' (出雲乃伊波比神社, いづものいわいのかむやしろ, いずものいわいじんじゃ) refers to the name of a Shinto shrine.

* '''Izumo-no-Iwai Shrine''' - A small shrine listed under the ''Engishiki'' in {{ill|Musashi Province|en|Musashi Province|qid=Q907398|lt=Musashi Province|1=Musashi Province}} {{ill|Obusuma District|ja|男衾郡|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Obusuma District|1=Obusuma district|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11578175}}. There are two candidate shrines.
* {{ill|Izumo-no-Iwai Shrine (Yorii Town)|ja|出雲乃伊波比神社 (寄居町)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Izumo-no-Iwai Shrine (Yorii Town)}} - Located in {{ill|Yorii, Saitama|en|Yorii, Saitama|qid=Q961604|lt=Yorii Town|1=Yorii, Saitama}}, {{ill|Ōsato District, Saitama|en|Ōsato District, Saitama|qid=Q1075196|lt=Ōsato District|1=Ōsato District, Saitama}}, {{ill|Saitama Prefecture|en|Saitama Prefecture|qid=Q128186|lt=Saitama Prefecture|1=Saitama Prefecture}} (formerly Obusuma District). One of the candidate shrines.
* {{ill|Izumo-no-Iwai Shrine (Kumagaya City)|ja|出雲乃伊波比神社 (熊谷市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Izumo-no-Iwai Shrine (Kumagaya City)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Located in {{ill|Kumagaya|en|Kumagaya|qid=Q41106|lt=Kumagaya City|1=Kumagaya}}, Saitama Prefecture (formerly Obusuma District). Another of the candidate shrines.
